title: Implement the psp-etl ingest CLI command (issue L5). The CLI uses Click with a top-level --data-dir group option. Add an 'ingest' subcommand to src/psp_etl/cli.py that: accepts a ROM file or directory path; scans directories for *.rom/*.bin/*.cap; creates data_dir/roms/ and data_dir/blobs/ if needed; calls ingest_rom() from src/psp_etl/ingest.py; shows rich progress; exits 0 even on parse errors. See DESIGN.md CLI Interface for full spec.
